header.title: Area Chart
header.subtitle: Single-series area chart built on Recharts AreaChart. Renders a filled gradient area with a stroke line, responsive to its container. Sort and formatters are caller-supplied — the component is purely presentational.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: The chart is composed of Recharts primitives wrapped in a ResponsiveContainer. The gradient is defined in a defs block and referenced by the Area fill.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Pass data, xKey, and yKey. The color defaults to var(--accent). Hover to see the tooltip.

formatters.title: With formatters
formatters.description: formatY controls the Y-axis tick labels. formatTooltip controls the value shown in the tooltip on hover. Both receive a number and return a string — localise them from the call site.

yLabel.title: With yLabel
yLabel.description: Pass yLabel to replace the raw yKey string in the tooltip label row. Use a localised string from t() at the call site — the snippet uses a literal for illustration only.

colors.title: Custom colors
colors.description: Pass any CSS color to the color prop. Use system tokens (var(--success), var(--warning), var(--info)) rather than hardcoded hex values so the chart adapts to theme switches.

gradient.title: Multiple charts on the same page
gradient.description: Each AreaChart instance generates a unique gradient ID via React.useId(), so two charts with the same yKey on the same page do not share their gradient. Both render independently.

loading.title: Loading and error states
loading.description: Wrap AreaChart with the standard feedback pattern: ChartSkeleton while loading, ErrorState on error, EmptyState for empty data. This is the canonical reference for all chart showcases.

props.title: Props
props.description: All props except data, xKey, and yKey are optional.

anatomy.responsiveContainer: Responsive wrapper — fills parent width, uses the height prop
anatomy.areaChart: Recharts AreaChart root — receives data array and margin config
anatomy.defs: SVG defs block — holds the linearGradient definition
anatomy.linearGradient: Gradient definition — fades from color at 20% opacity to transparent; ID is unique per instance via React.useId()
anatomy.cartesianGrid: Horizontal grid lines — uses chartGridProps from @lib/charts
anatomy.xAxis: Bottom axis — renders tick labels from xKey; uses chartAxisProps
anatomy.yAxis: Left axis — renders tick labels via formatY; uses chartAxisProps
anatomy.tooltip: Hover overlay — styled via chartTooltipStyle, value formatted by formatTooltip
anatomy.area: Filled area shape — gradient fill + solid stroke at color, no dots except on hover

gradient.note: Two AreaChart instances with the same yKey — each has its own gradient ID generated by React.useId(). No shared gradient, no visual bleed-through.

loading.skeletonNote: ChartSkeleton type="area" matches the shape of an AreaChart.
loading.errorNote: ErrorState covers the chart slot with a retry button.
loading.emptyNote: EmptyState is shown when data is an empty array.

props.data: Array of data objects. Each object must contain the xKey and yKey fields.
props.xKey: Key of the field used for X-axis labels.
props.yKey: Key of the field used for Y-axis values and the Area dataKey.
props.color: Fill and stroke color. Defaults to var(--accent). Use CSS custom properties for theme compatibility.
props.yLabel: Human-readable label shown in the tooltip instead of the raw yKey string. Pass a localised string from t() at the call site.
props.formatY: Formats Y-axis tick labels. Receives a number, returns a string.
props.formatTooltip: Formats the value in the tooltip. Receives a number, returns a string.
props.height: Chart height in pixels. Defaults to 220.
